name: EmuELEC
notes: The BIOS folder is /storage/roms/bios, inside the roms root: the scan skips it.
A file is a game only when its lowercased extension is in the folder's list (es es-app/src/SystemData.cpp:275).
Systems whose command or platform is 'ignore' (screenshots, music) are no game folder.
Default core: the core marked default, else the first emulator's first core (es es-app/src/SystemData.cpp:1828-1860).
